reviews.body: Thanks for picking this up! Tested against the #2210 repro and it works, found one regression below.

review_comments.body: An unquoted attribute value that ends in `/` gets read as self-closing here, so `link` turns into `link`. This needs to skip the `/>` check while an unquoted value is still open, and needs a test covering it.

comments.body: Thanks for the review. Fixed in b4ec770: the start-tag scanner now tracks unquoted attribute values, so a trailing `/` that belongs to the value (`link`) is no longer read as self-closing. Added a test covering `href=/foo/>`, `href = /foo/ >` and a genuine ``; it fails without the change and passes with it. This comment was drafted with AI assistance (Claude Code); the change was tested by running the spec file above.
